title: V-Party + V-Dem anti-pluralism classification output
description: Schema for vparty_antipluralism_v1.md output. Consumed by structured-output APIs. Field semantics, scoring rubric, and few-shot examples live in the companion .md prompt; this file only enforces shape.

score.description: Holistic V-Party + V-Dem anti-pluralism grade applied to the speech as a whole. Holistic, not algorithmic — see prompt rubric.

framework_confidence.description: Confidence in the rubric application (not in the speech's meaning). Calibrated per the prompt's confidence table.

markers.description: Evidence-anchored marker records. May be empty for unambiguous score-0 speeches. Markers in non-first-person voice are emitted as evidence anchors but do not contribute to the score.

text.description: Exact substring from the speech excerpt. char_offsets are computed downstream by the harness via string search.

preliminary_voice.description: Best-effort voice from Pass-1 region hints + the prompt's own read; voice_classifier_v1 may refine downstream.

marker_confidence.description: Confidence that the marker fires — separate from voice confidence.

rationale_short.description: One sentence in Romanian explaining why this marker fires, ≤ 200 characters.

rationale.description: One paragraph (3–6 sentences) in Romanian explaining the holistic score and how the markers (or their absence) sustain or fail to sustain an anti-pluralist worldview across the speech.
